'''Pickle soup''' is a style of [[soup]] prepared with various types of [[Pickling|pickled]] vegetables. Dill pickle soup is a variety of pickle soup prepared with [[pickled cucumber]].<ref name="WCA"/> Some versions use grated dill pickle in their preparation.<ref name="TECPB"/> Some restaurants in the United States offer this dish to their patrons, such as Polish grocery stores and restaurants in [[Chicago's south side]].<ref name="Hirschfelder">{{cite book | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=RlMdctXx6H4C&pg=PA113 | title=Children of the U.S.A | pages=113| isbn=9781570916151 | last1=Ajmera | first1=Maya | year=2008 }}</ref>
